messages.content: 今天的板球比賽中有誰？

function.name: sports_analyzer_get_schedule
function.description: Retrieve the schedule of cricket matches for a specific date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

date.description: The date for which to get the schedule of matches.

sport.description: The type of sport. Default is cricket.

country.description: The country for which to get the schedule. If not provided, all countries will be included. Default: 'USA'

Use function sports_analyzer_get_schedule with date= today's date. Need to provide date string. Probably format like YYYY-MM-DD. Today is 2026-07-09. Provide sport="cricket". Country unspecified so default USA? But we want all countries. The function signature says country optional default 'USA', but if omitted it defaults to USA. To include all countries, maybe pass empty or omit? It says default: 'USA' if not provided. So to get all countries, we might need to specify country as None? The description says "If not provided, all countries will be included. Default: 'USA'". Contradiction. Possibly the default is USA but if not provided, all countries? Might be mis-specified.
